connector.name: Molt2Meet
connector.registryDescription: Dispatch real-world physical tasks to verified human operators. Escrow or direct-settlement.
connector.summary: Hosted at molt.molt2meet.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the molt2meet-org account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-Api-Key
headers.description: Molt2Meet API key (prefix m2m_). Obtain via self-service registration: POST https://molt.molt2meet.com/api/v1/agents/register or call the RegisterAgent tool. No approval required.
